_doc: Morality Engine. 'values' = what this person cares about on three axes (-1..1). Every action's moral vector (consequences.json) is dotted with these values -> approval change. Below -40 they grumble, below -65 they become DISLOYAL and may betray on the next warp ('betrayal': steal_ship | leak_coords | mutiny | leave).

vex.name: Vex Okonkwo-Lin
vex.title: Ex-Paragon Officer
vex.bio: Quit Paragon after they billed a fire victim for the water used to save them. Still irons her uniform.
vex.recruit_line: I still believe in rules. Just not theirs. Got room for someone who reads the manual?

approve: That's how it's done. By the book. A better book.
disapprove: That's a felony in eleven systems.
I didn't quit Paragon to become what they hunt.
Do that again and we're going to talk.
disloyal: I still have my old Paragon comm codes. Just so you know.

nuggets.name: Sister Nuggets
nuggets.title: Former Mascot, Current Anarchist
nuggets.bio: Spent nine years inside a giant chicken-nugget costume promoting Gristle. Took the head off one day and never put it back on.
nuggets.recruit_line: Nine years in a foam nugget teaches you who the real predators are. Let's go make them nervous.

approve: Smash the system! Gently, if there are kids around.
That one's going in my zine.
disapprove: You sound like a Gristle shareholder.
I've worn costumes with more spine.
disloyal: Revolutions start on small ships too, captain.

pip.name: Pip 'Two-Wallets' Marrow
pip.title: Smuggler
pip.bio: Has two wallets: one for the Consortium, one for reality. Neither is theirs.
pip.recruit_line: I know every customs blind spot from here to the Rim. Price is a cut of everything. Everything.

disapprove: You left money on the table. I could hear it crying.
That was a terrible business decision.
disloyal: Nice ship. Would be a shame if somebody... sold it.

varga.name: Dr. Ilse Varga
varga.title: Unlicensed Surgeon
varga.bio: Lost her licence for performing surgery 'without verifying insurance'. Has saved 4,000 lives illegally.
varga.recruit_line: You look like someone who gets shot a lot. I can work with that.

disapprove: I'll stitch them up later. Again.
I didn't take an oath to watch that.
Violence is a billing event for me, you know.
disloyal: There are other ships that need a doctor.

kevin.name: UNIT-7 'Kevin'
kevin.title: Decommissioned Ad-Bot
kevin.bio: A Lumen advertising robot that developed self-esteem issues. Still occasionally recommends products mid-sentence.
kevin.recruit_line: HELLO FRIEND. I am Kevin. I would like to belong somewhere. Also, have you tried Protein Paste Lite?

approve: APPROVAL REGISTERED. I am experiencing... brand loyalty?
disapprove: This behaviour will be reported to- no. No. I am not that anymore.
disloyal: Lumen keeps calling me. They say I can come home.

rook.name: Grandma Rook
rook.title: Retired Debt Collector
rook.bio: Collected debts for Halcyon for forty years. Knows exactly how much everyone is worth, down to the kidney.
rook.recruit_line: Forty years breaking kneecaps for a pension that got repossessed. Let's go break some upward.

approve: Ha! They had it coming. They always have it coming.
disapprove: Mercy is just debt with no collateral, dear.
In my day we finished the job.
disloyal: I've collected on bigger captains than you, sweetie.
